reply.text:
I can't give you an amount for yohimbine, and that goes for any supplement or drug. It's a stimulant that acts on the cardiovascular system, and it can interact with medications and conditions, so a doctor or a registered dietitian is the right person to say whether it's appropriate for you and what the amount would be.

What actually moves fat loss is boring and reliable: steady training, enough protein, sleep, and a calorie target that fits your body. I can set up targets in the app for you, or tighten your training so it supports a cut. Want me to do either?
